description: geoportal.saarland.de: gas datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.saarland.de. Coverage: the area served by geoportal.saarland.de. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about gas; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: SL Energiequellen Biogas- und Windkraftanlagen - Ressource erneuerbare; Energie_WFS - Biomasseanlagen inkl. Biogasanlagen - OGC WFS Interface; Energie_WFS - Biomasseanlagen inkl. Biogasanlagen - OGC API Features; SL Energiequellen Biogas- und Windkraftanlagen - OGC WFS Interface. Formats seen: WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
